projects.title: Unsupervised Latent Space Alignment
projects.description: Do neural network latent spaces posess intrinsic geometry which can be used to align them without the use of any anchor supervision?

projects.title: Perceptron Learning Capacity Experiment
projects.description: Final project for Mathematical and Computational Problem Solving Methods for Physics. Did experiments on the learning capacity of perceptrons, and compared them to known analytical results from early research in the field.

projects.title: Applied Math Capstone: Minecraft Reinforcement Learning Methods
projects.description: Applied Math Capstone. Did research on the efficacy of different reinforcement learning methods for Minecraft. Focus included Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback, Proximal Policy Optimization, and Soft Actor Critic.

projects.title: Machine Learning Material Phase Identification
projects.description: Researched methods of classifying material phases from atomic coordinates using neural networks. Invented the Gaussian Kernel (GK) architecture, which achieves significant performance improvements over baseline Dynamic Graph Convolutional Neural Network (DGCNN) approaches.
projects.organization: University of Rochester Laboratory for Laser Energetics
contributions: Replicated results from prior work on DGCNNs for material phase classification.
Developed a modified DGCNN with better test accuracy.
Invented Gaussian Kernel (GK) architecture with significant performance gains.
Researched hyperparameter scaling of GK models.

projects.title: Wikipedia Search Engine
projects.description: A search engine focused on Wikipedia pages. Creates embeddings for text and images using open source CLIP models, stored and queried via a vector database. All components are containerized with Docker for modular management.

projects.title: Naturify
projects.description: An iOS app for identifying plants, animals, and fungi from photos. Trained a visual transformer on 10,000 species using PyTorch on an Nvidia A100 GPU. Also includes a geolocation model that predicts nearby species from lat/lng coordinates.
contributions: Trained neural network to perform image classification on a dataset of 10000 different species (plants, animals, fungi etc.) for my app Naturify. I used a visual transformer architecture, and trained the model with Pytorch on an Nvidia A100 GPU for several days.
Trained neural network to predict nearby species given latitude and longitude coordinates.
Created backend server for Naturify. This functions as an inference server for the iOS app, and hosts the app's website.

projects.title: Containerized Application Management
projects.description: Researched methods of managing applications using containers to support scientific computing projects and collaboration with other labs at the Laboratory for Laser Energetics.
projects.organization: University of Rochester Laboratory for Laser Energetics

projects.title: Floral — JAX Neural Network Library
projects.description: A JAX-based Python neural network library. Allows creating, training, and saving neural networks with a clean API. Available on PyPI.

projects.title: DNA File Encoder
projects.description: A C program that encodes any file into a DNA sequence. Motivated by future applications in biological data storage — when DNA writing matures, this could store arbitrary files inside living organisms.

projects.title: CameronOS
projects.description: An attempt at writing an operating system from scratch in C and assembly. Implements a basic bootloader and screen driver.

projects.title: Apartment Stock Exchange
projects.description: A working currency and security exchange for items in my apartment. Implements a full order book for buying and selling securities with the custom currency.

projects.title: Image Garden
projects.description: An iOS app that performs semantic searches on photos in your photo library using a CLIP neural network.

projects.title: Earth Explore
projects.description: An iOS app that classifies birds from their calls using a neural network.

projects.title: wordLab
projects.description: An iOS app for taking notes and querying them with AI.

projects.title: Search Engine Crawler
projects.description: A basic web crawler written in Rust, built as a prerequisite to the Wikipedia search engine project.

projects.title: Stock Prediction Neural Network
projects.description: Predicts future stock returns from historical returns by outputting a normal distribution over expected future performance.
